scope: Offline A-only research. No production, Phase D, Q/L/D/R/commitment/prior/tiers/optimizer/Phase9F/overlay changes.
builds: Reuse frozen D qualification and exact fit/audit/target rows. One observed configuration, unique40-card modal build, >=3 games, positive resolved quantities and12-20 lands. No acquisition or wins-based fit selection. Fit accepts cards/evidence key only.
auditSplit: D internal audit hashes split into utility and confidence halves with this phase seed; neither trains composition. Utility measures per-shell residual benefit; confidence half fits global calibration mapping using calibration sets only. Target builds never fit any parameters/model/utility.
baselineSequence: Fit/freeze all generic controls before residual candidate testing. Coefficients fit on calibration structure; choose ridge via calibration internal audit log loss. Evaluate frozen controls on target calibration/development tasks and preregister primary strongest macro development control before testing candidates. This baseline-only development use cannot change any candidate design or parameter grid.
genericInclusion: Small binomial ridge logistic model over card/shell opportunities: logit global inclusion, logit shrunk shell inclusion, frozen Q, mana value and missingness, color compatibility, creature/instant-sorcery/artifact-enchantment/land type flags, assigned removal/fixing and explicit unassigned-role indicators. No rarity/outcome/future features. Ridge grid1/10/100;120 deterministic Newton updates max with line search. Global coefficients calibrated only, set marginals fit disjoint build evidence.
shell: Same D two-largest spell-color-load definition; basics excluded, lands describe fixing only. Pool shell beliefs stay soft and candidate independent.

families.A: Shell log-odds residual relative to generic inclusion; half-sample sign/standard-error/card-support shrinkage; no factors/pairs
families.B: A plus small-rank residual latent factor contribution, support/stability/card uncertainty gated
families.C: B plus deconfounded sign/SE-gated pair residual; disjoint per-shell utility gate and calibrated monotonic cold confidence

factorGrid: Compare logistic offset factorization and signed residualized NMF at rank1/2/4; biases fixed generic+shrunk shell residual, common cards >=20 inclusions. Logistic100 ridge-gradient updates, NMF100 multiplicative updates. Select method/rank by equally weighted calibration utility-audit masked-card log loss, smallest rank/method simplicity tie. Fixed ridge. No authored labels.
cardUncertainty: Residual zero at missing support. Shrink count/(count+50), half-sample sign agreement, and |residual|/(|residual|+1.64*SElogodds); factors also shrink by card count/(count+50). Fits remain bounded; uncertainty is not a probability.
factorUncertainty: Matched half-sample signed loading cosine >=.8, effective shell evidence n/(n+100), card inclusion >=20; otherwise suppress. Mathematical stability alone is insufficient for C without positive held-out utility.
pair: Compare generic-only and generic+latent expected co-occurrence. Positive observed>=5, expected>=5 and both marginals>=20; low-observed negative expected>=20 and marginals>=30. Effect clip(log((observed+5)/(expected+5)),-1,1). Reliability sign consistency*expected/(expected+50)*clip(1-1.64*SElog/abs(effect),0,1).2/2=0. Pair average coefficient.25; no double count generic or shared factor effects.
utility: Per-shell disjoint utility-audit paired completion gain against frozen strongest generic control. Require >=10 tasks and positive 80%-one-sided lower bound meanGain-.84*SE across drafts. Weight clip(lowerBound/.02,0,1). Also record masked-card log loss and stable no-utility suppression. No set-name branching, including OTJ.
primaryTasks: Outcome-independent lowest-hash one masked nonland occurrence identity per target build, all copies removed; up to500/set; four distractors absent from build, exact colors and primary creature/spell/land type, mana within1, Q within.05, generic probability ratio.75-1.3333, inclusion/opportunity-support ratio.5-2. >=300 tasks in each development set; undercoverage fails, never loosen after results.
primaryPredictionVsA: Completion forecasts rank strongest generic baseline plus residual learned logit offset. Zero confidence equals the exact generic control, never fabricated strategy proof. A-only contextual replay maps ONLY residual offset to .5+.25*tanh(offset), then blends with original A. Generic inclusion/Q/frequency is NOT copied into A.
familyParameterSelection: Representation inherited D, method/rank and pool weighting calibrated only; family selection maximizes development equal-set completion MRR. Exact parameters and baseline freeze precede development candidate results. No post-development/OTJ/holdout tuning.
cold: Nested lowest-hash evidence builds50/100/250/500/1000/full. Models/marginals use only sampled evidence, fixed generic coefficients/form/primary control and identical full-task targets. Calibration confidence-half tasks choose largest alpha in0/.25/.5/.75/1 with no mean loss in every calibration set at that level. Lower monotonic envelope across levels gives piecewise interpolation in log build count. No size-specific changes to factor/pair formulas.
uncertaintyCalibration: Fixed confidence bins0,.1,.25,.5,.75,1; report paired completion lift, inclusion label rate, residual Brier/logloss error and n. Calibration confidence-half fits nonnegative isotonic predicted lift; development evaluates weighted absolute lift calibration error<=.02, zero downward lift violations >.01 between bins with>=30 tasks, >=100 positive-confidence development tasks. No nonempty useful bins means FAIL, not perfect calibration.
metadataPrior: Optional weak calibration-only generic role/mana/type residual covariance prior, no set mechanics/NLP/rarity/Q bonus. Compare cold alpha0/.05/.10 on calibration confidence tasks; adopt only if all calibration sets nonnegative. Evaluate separately on development50/100/250; reject unless each level noninferior and aggregate positive. It is not assumed useful or installed.
primaryGate: >=2% relative macro MRR gain over strongest frozen generic control; improve>=4/5 development sets; no set >2% relative loss; >=300 tasks/set
coldGate: At50/100/250 each development set no more than1% relative MRR loss to same frozen strongest functional baseline;500 noninferior macro;1000/full positive macro; high-confidence bins must have positive lift. Safe zero-weight fallback counts only as safety, not primary benefit.
otherGates: Uncertainty calibration, prescribed low-support/unstable/no-utility/empty-pool/splash/hybrid probes,40 production goldens, baseline replay identity and complete A-only component isolation all required.
replay: Reuse frozen existing B.1/C/D C# replay runner and A-only recomposition without altering its source. Raw helper labels retain D version; D1 explicit execution-scope/model/prediction hashes identify new namespace. Output only under phase-d1. >=50000 comparable full-context decisions if practical; actual-pick agreement secondary. D trace can supply frozen D-C comparison without rerunning D.
otj: Only after rules frozen, compare all eight sets on shell n/ranks/stability/entropy/prevalence/frequency-Q/pairs/splashes/multicolor/fixing/bonus sheets/role coverage/distractors/diversity; ablate generic, shell, factor, pair, factor+pair and gated full. OTJ is diagnostic, never a tuning target.
holdout: Freeze all formulations, parameters, mapping, utility/cold rules and evidence hashes. Consume MH3/DFT exactly once only if every primary/per-set/cold/calibration/probe/golden/context-integrity gate passes. On any failure, no download/performance read/release lock. No post-holdout tuning. Existing runner cannot bypass protected sets; any passing release needs permitted separately qualified D1 inputs and its own single-use release.
performance: Fit, peak memory, per-set/total compact model bytes, pool/inference mean/P95 and amortized actual candidate cost; artifacts no raw draft rows/outcomes
tests: Grouped meaningful tests for frozen production/PhaseD, no target leakage, generic baseline, residualization, uncertainty/utility/stability/pairs/cold/calibration/fallback/pool/splash/holdouts and reused A-only helper. No redundant C# copy of existing D tests.
stop: Publish V2_PHASE_D1_ARCHETYPE_DECONFOUNDING_COLD_START.md and machine evidence; no production change or next phase
